name: director-comfyui
notes: Official ComfyUI template. Attach network volume t023496m3n (600 GB, US-NC-2), then from the repo run: python infra/runpod/one_click.py --full. Models, node packs, and workflows live on the volume; one_click binds every Comfy model folder (including upscale_models) so loaders never see an empty list.
